purpose: State whether the MathBridge core research dataset is complete under the rule that every required item is verified, explicitly unavailable/query-dependent, or excluded as unsupported.
completion_definition: Verified data has an appropriate source and preserves source authority/limitations.
Data that cannot be recovered reliably from public sources is explicitly classified rather than guessed.
Rollout/use fields that inherently depend on locality, publisher and term are query-dependent rather than globally missing.
Unsupported or overbroad claims are removed/downgraded rather than filled by inference.
core_scope: Revised PEP primary mathematics series as the China textbook comparison layer
England primary mathematics teaching guidance/NCETM guidance
US Common Core Grades 1-6 comparison baseline

current_state.cn_exact_single_page_per_bullet: not_recoverable_with_current_pdf_access; renderer uses verified printed range + hierarchy
current_state.us_state_overlays: optional extension; California/Texas seed covers 14 high-use concepts

completed_layers.note: Publicly recoverable current/revised detail is stored where available; later-semester/unexposed detail is explicitly classified and never inferred.
3 ISBNs verified; one single-source candidate remains unverified; others are explicitly not publicly recovered or not yet applicable to the documented rollout.
Series design is separated from locality/publisher/term actual use; there is intentionally no single nationwide PEP-use state.

completed_layers.coverage: 数与代数 p17-26; 图形与几何 p27-35; 统计与概率 p36-41; 综合与实践 p42-52 plus learning-stage hierarchy

completed_layers.note: National-use frequency is never inferred from guidance.
No unresolved technical-debt items remain in the refreshed source audit.

classified_limits_not_open_research.item: Exact single printed page for every individual China 2022 curriculum bullet
classified_limits_not_open_research.safe_behavior: Use verified printed domain range + exact hierarchy/stage/subsection; never fabricate a page.
Do not display an unverified ISBN; sequence/unit placement remains independently verified.

classified_limits_not_open_research.item: Grade 4-6 lower revised PEP below-unit classroom artifacts as of 2026-08-18
classified_limits_not_open_research.safe_behavior: Show designed revised-series sequence; do not claim current classroom use.
Require/resolve locality + publisher + term when actual-use status matters.

classified_limits_not_open_research.item: Peer-reviewed direct evidence for every diagnostic probe
classified_limits_not_open_research.safe_behavior: Probe-only records remain instructional hypotheses; never call them research-established.
Use Common Core as the labelled US baseline; California/Texas overlays only when selected and available.

publication_policy: Show exact revised-PEP grade/semester/unit placement from the canonical sequence.
Only show PEP below-unit detail at its registered evidence level.
Do not call PEP the national textbook or imply simultaneous nationwide adoption.
Use China 2022 learning-stage/domain evidence independently from PEP textbook placement.
Every misconception retains its canonical evidence class and diagnostic questions remain probes, not validated assessments.
Common Core is a labelled US baseline unless a specific state overlay is selected.
